quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 40

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after you make a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules that drivers must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: A bus is signaling to pull back onto the road after stopping. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to let them know you are there.
Speed up to pass the bus.

questions.explanation: You must let any bus merge back onto the road after it stops. Slow down, change lanes, or stop to give the bus room to enter the traffic safely.

questions.question: You are in the left lane and want to move to the right lane. What should you do?

options.text: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders before changing lanes.
Check mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot. Always check your mirrors and use your turn signal before you change lanes.

questions.question: What do yellow painted curbs mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow curbs mark areas where you cannot park. They may show loading zones, fire hydrants, or other no-parking areas.

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Using safe techniques to prevent crashes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using safe techniques to prevent crashes.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means using safe techniques to avoid crashes. It means adjusting your driving based on weather, how you feel, and what other drivers, cyclists, and pedestrians are doing.

questions.question: When you get in a car to drive, what should you adjust first?
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel to work with your new seat position.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Signal as you move into the next lane.
Signal 500 feet before you change lanes on residential streets.

questions.explanation: Vehicles can hide in your blind spot, so look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet ahead on residential streets or 5 seconds ahead on freeways before you change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.
There is a dangerous curve ahead.
There is a bump in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you to drive carefully because wet pavement can be slippery and hard to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: If you pass a stopped school bus with its lights flashing, what will happen?

options.text: You will be fined at least $265.
You will be fined less than $100.
Your license will be suspended, but you will not be fined.
There will be no legal consequences.

questions.correctAnswerText: You will be fined at least $265.
questions.explanation: You must stop completely when a school bus's lights are flashing. If you do not stop, you will be fined at least $265. If you pass on the side where the bus door is open, the fine is at least $465. Other penalties may also apply.

questions.question: You are driving in the left lane and a faster car is behind you. What should you do?

options.text: You have the right to stay in the left lane.
You must move out of the left lane.
You should ignore the other vehicle.
You should brake to slow down the other driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must move out of the left lane.
questions.explanation: By law, you must move out of the left lane when a faster car is passing you from behind. Move safely into another lane.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line in the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean you cannot pass.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Be ready to adjust your driving if you see this signal.

questions.question: When may you use your horn?

options.text: When you have to stop quickly.
When you are passing another car.
When you have lost control of your car.
When you are passing a bicyclist.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you have lost control of your car.
questions.explanation: Use your horn when you lose control of your vehicle. This alerts other drivers to a hazard.

questions.question: To pass a slower car on a two-lane, two-way road, you must:

options.text: Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: On a two-lane, two-way road, you must use the lane for oncoming traffic to pass safely. Only pass when it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: How much alcohol does your body process in one hour?
questions.explanation: Your body processes about one drink per hour on average. Many factors affect how impaired you become, including the amount of alcohol, how fast you drink it, your weight, food intake, and overall health.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are usually yellow warnings. Orange diamond signs are used in work areas. These signs alert you to hazards or areas with special rules.

questions.question: Two vehicles enter an intersection at the same time from different roads. Who must yield?
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. This applies to all types of intersections.

questions.question: You are driving on a narrow road and meet an oncoming vehicle. What must you do?

options.text: Pull completely off the road and stop.
Give the oncoming vehicle at least half of the road.
Demand that the other vehicle pull over.
Turn on your high beams so they can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the oncoming vehicle at least half of the road.
questions.explanation: On narrow roads, you must give oncoming traffic at least half of the road space. Both drivers need adequate space to pass safely.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will also have text to confirm it is a no passing zone.

questions.question: When changing lanes, how should you check your blind spots?

options.text: Use both inside and outside rearview mirrors.
Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check your blind spots before every lane change.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly and your vehicle does not have anti-lock brakes, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop a car in an emergency. Your car will stop quickly and you can still steer.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly disrupts the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.
When driving under bad weather conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly disrupts the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you disrupt the normal flow of traffic. You can receive a citation for driving too slowly.

questions.question: What do round signs mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs warn drivers of an upcoming railroad crossing. Drivers should use extra caution when approaching a railroad crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead and you should prepare to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does a red and white triangular sign at an intersection mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white yield sign means you must slow down and yield the right-of-way to any vehicles or pedestrians in the intersection. Be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or for driving straight through.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: A driver's left arm and hand extended downward means they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following a driver using this hand signal.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines dividing it. You may:

options.text: Cross these lines only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross these lines to pass other vehicles if there is no oncoming traffic.
Cross these lines only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross these lines only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean passing is not allowed in either direction. You may only cross them to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: What does a regulatory sign with a red circle and slash through the middle mean?

options.text: Drivers should come to a complete stop.
Some drivers should yield to other drivers.
Drivers should drive under the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs with a red circle and slash mean an action is forbidden. These signs are white with red and black markings.

questions.question: You must pull over to the edge of the road and let an emergency vehicle pass:

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: You must pull over to the right edge of the road and stop for an emergency vehicle with flashing lights. It does not matter if it is coming from behind you or from the opposite direction.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street without using its emergency lights. You should:

options.text: Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you but not using its siren or flashing lights, you do not need to clear the road. Drive normally.

questions.question: What is NOT a factor in how far it takes to stop your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change based on your speed and road conditions.

questions.question: ____ greatly increase stopping distance and crash severity.
questions.explanation: High speeds greatly increase stopping distance and how severe a crash will be. The faster you drive, the harder your vehicle will hit in a collision.

questions.question: Unless a sign says otherwise, the speed limit in towns, business areas, and residential areas is ____ mph.
questions.explanation: The default speed limit in towns, business areas, and residential areas is 30 mph. Follow posted signs if they show a different speed limit.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has several turns or curves.

questions.question: Before turning left, you should:

options.text: Swing to the right side of your lane.
Wait until oncoming traffic has a red light.

questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic signal, you must let pedestrians and oncoming traffic pass before you turn.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. After completing the turn, your car should be in:

options.text: The lane with the least traffic.

questions.explanation: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, complete your turn into the leftmost lane.

questions.question: Hydroplaning is usually caused by:
questions.explanation: As you drive faster, your tires cannot clear water from the road as well. If you drive too fast, your tires lose grip and the vehicle slides on a layer of water. This is hydroplaning.

questions.question: You must yield to other drivers:

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When a vehicle on your left reaches an unmarked intersection at the same time as you.
When your traffic signal is a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: You must yield to other drivers when entering a street from a garage, driveway, or alley. You must also yield to pedestrians on an intersecting sidewalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is coming. Slow down when entering a roundabout and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: In normal weather and traffic, what is the minimum safe distance between your car and the car ahead?
questions.explanation: Keep at least four seconds of distance between your car and the car ahead in normal conditions. This gives you time to react if something goes wrong. Increase this distance in bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: If you are 21 or older, at what blood alcohol level are you legally considered to be driving under the influence?
questions.explanation: A blood alcohol level of 0.08 percent or higher means you are driving under the influence. You can face fines, jail time, or both.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with no warning lights or gates?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will never happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At unmarked railroad crossings, slow down and be prepared to stop. Look both ways on all tracks before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait for it to pass before you cross.

questions.question: What colors are highway exit distance signs?
questions.explanation: Signs that show directions and distances are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into or out of a driveway, or to make a U-turn where it is legal.

questions.question: When driving to a place you do not know, what should you do?

options.text: Rely on road signs to guide you.
Plan your trip before you start driving.
You only need to know the general area.
Always take the most direct route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Plan your trip in advance before you drive. Check a map before leaving so you know exactly where you are going.

questions.question: Stopping completely, letting other traffic and pedestrians pass, then going through an intersection when it is safe matches which light?
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely, let other traffic and pedestrians go, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What is the fine for exceeding the speed limit by more than 50 mph on a first offense?
questions.explanation: The fine for going more than 50 mph over the speed limit is $1,000 for the first time. A second offense costs $2,500.

questions.question: What should you do when you reach a railroad crossing without flashing lights or gates?

options.text: Cross right away as fast as possible.
Be ready to stop for any train.
Speed up to beat any oncoming train.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop for any train.
questions.explanation: Always be ready to stop for trains at crossings, especially if there are no lights or gates. Wait until your entire car can fit on the other side of the tracks before crossing. Do not shift gears while crossing because your car might stall.
